subject: Isolated S5 positive-progress retry terminated before route movement
scope: One attempted copied-client retry after correcting the dry-bank packet guard. The ordinary copied Game DLL and archived post-corpse DB were used, with only copied objective 1995/1 timer anchor reset. Neither the second sandbag nor bomb was reached.

observations.finding: The isolated Auth/Game and client launched and one gameplay-readiness screenshot was written, but the driver log remained empty. Both launcher and driver later returned exit code 143, consistent with SIGTERM. No isolated process remained; status.json was absent. The cause of termination was not established. The ephemeral command directory was not archived, so the exact command sequence cannot be re-inspected from this archive.
observations.source_location: private archive 00-playable.png, client.log, game.log and driver-second-sandbag.log; terminal exit-code and process observations before archive

observations.finding: No route movement input was issued. Character mission 1995 remained state 0, objective 1 active, objectives 2 and 3 complete; SQLite integrity was ok. The attempted retry supplies no evidence about second-sandbag clearance.
observations.source_location: driver-second-sandbag.log empty; state-after-stop.json; driver source code

guard_revision.finding: The archived copied driver now polls all fresh accepted packets for up to 8 seconds and requires both spatial movement and positive progress toward the current target before concluding success. This addresses the delayed positive packet observed in bootcamp-s5-second-sandbag-probe-interrupted-20260924.json; it was not exercised in this terminated retry.
